Everything that needs a decision, soonest first

Sorted by the date each decision stops being reversible, not by how loud it is. A campground that has to be phoned outranks a note about a photograph, because one changes where you sleep.

What has to be booked next

Sorted by when the reservation window opens — not by trip order. The campgrounds that sell out do so within minutes of opening, so this is the one screen where being early matters more than being organised.

Statuses, notes and confirmation numbers are stored in this browser only. Every republish of this dashboard is a new file — export before you replace it, then import into the new one, or the record goes with the old build.

Ask Claude about this trip

Pick a stop and the question goes out with everything already known about it — the dates, the campground, whether the coach fits, the Google rating and how old it is, anything already flagged, and how the site is actually booked. That is the part worth sending; the typing is the small part. The exact text is at the bottom of this page before it goes anywhere.

What Claude should do with it

What gets sent

Nothing is sent until you press the button, and the full text always goes to the clipboard first — so if the app does not open, or the link is too long for it, the brief is still sitting there to paste. The link itself is capped at the far end, so a long brief is cut in the link and marked where it was cut. The clipboard copy is never cut.

  Built from stop-by-stop research (AllTrails, onX Offroad / Trailforks / Trails Offroad, Reddit & RV forums, campground/boondock data) compiled July 2026.
